title: Message history auto-compaction for long conversations

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
## Epic Purpose

Add auto-compaction capability to Tactus MessageHistoryManager to support long conversations without manual overflow handling.

## Context

**Related Plexus work**: Epic `plx-e923c4` in Plexus repo refactors console chat to use Tactus infrastructure. This Tactus epic delivers the reusable compaction primitives that Plexus (and other Tactus users) will leverage.

**Problem**: Current MessageHistoryManager has no built-in mechanism to handle history that exceeds token budgets. Agents must manually detect overflow and handle compaction, leading to duplicated logic across consumers.

**Solution**: Add pluggable `CompactionStrategy` interface and automatic compaction in `MessageHistoryManager.get_history()`.

## Goals

1. **CompactionStrategy interface**: Pluggable ABC with `should_compact()` and `compact()` methods
2. **RollingSummaryStrategy**: LLM-generated summaries of old turns, preserving recent N messages uncompressed
3. **Auto-compaction**: Transparent compaction when `auto_compact=True` and history exceeds configured budget
4. **Compaction metadata**: Store and retrieve summary text, tokens saved, message counts

## Architectural Boundary

**Tactus** (this epic):
- Generic CompactionStrategy interface
- RollingSummaryStrategy with LLM-based summarization
- Auto-compaction in MessageHistoryManager
- Compaction metadata storage

**Plexus** (epic `plx-e923c4`):
- Console-specific compaction configuration (recent window size, summary prompt style)
- S3 audit artifact upload
- Privacy filtering
- Tool access mode enforcement

## Definition of Done

- [ ] CompactionStrategy ABC in `tactus/core/compaction_strategies.py`
- [ ] RollingSummaryStrategy implementation
- [ ] MessageHistoryManager extended with auto-compaction
- [ ] Compaction metadata storage and retrieval
- [ ] All tests green
- [ ] Plexus can configure and use auto-compaction
